input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer, which satisfies the preferred position. Section 12.3 affirmatively confirms that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or conducting business in any field or territory, and that Customer has given no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. The only competing-product covenant runs the other way (12.4 binds Vendor not to develop or market a service competing with Customer's analytics products during the term), which benefits us and is not flagged. Section 13.4's reverse-engineering and acceptable-use limits are ordinary licence-scope restrictions, not a field-of-use or competitive-activity restraint, and are expressly qualified so they do not limit use of Customer Data and output. No redline required.
